A CORRECTION, NOT A NEW ADJUDICATION. bmdb 1554 hostap -rdynamic re-pass, batch 3 (src/ap/utils.c .. src/common/nan_de.c). Stacked on correction-rdynamic-1554-hostap-b02.

RULING. aurora-lint ADR-0011 6b28c8d7 (Brandon, 2026-09-25): wpa_supplicant/Makefile:1004-1006 links with -ldl -rdynamic under CONFIG_DYNAMIC_EAP_METHODS, a compilable configuration (ADR-0010), so every non-static function linked into wpa_supplicant has an open caller set and in-tree call sites prove nothing about its parameters. Also applied: a prior dereference is not a check (d9cb04d0); &p->field with p unproven is a violation site; a (pointer, length) pairing is a contract, not proof.

SCOPE. FP rows whose reason rested on callers, in non-static functions of files wpa_supplicant links under some configuration (the union of its Makefile OBJS under every ifdef). This batch covers 131 such rows. Held back and NOT changed here: 13 whose key realworld run 274 no longer emits (pending a ruling on non-emitted keys), 0 inside an #ifdef HOSTAPD / hostapd-only CONFIG_* arm that the wpa_supplicant build cannot compile.

METHOD. One read-only agent read every row at source at the pinned commit, judging the value the run-274 message names, and decided whether any basis inside the function or its callees holds (a dominating test, a NULL-tolerant callee, a language guarantee, a local value's own flow, or the site not being a violation site). A fresh-context refuter re-read a sample (39 rows: every emitted FP keep or non-high call plus 30 random TP flips; 39/39 upheld. The 7 INT16-C reasons were restated to the signedness basis.).

RESULT. 117 FP -> TP here (API00-C 108, INT16-C 7, EXP34-C 2): the only basis was the caller set. 1 stay FP with the reason restated to its local basis (a 1).

Mechanics: in-place edits keep each key; each original batch takes a row_count decrement and a superseded_rows record. Counting basis: distinct (project, commit, file, line, rule) keys. No precision claim is made here.
